text: Place seven grains of rice inside your wallet and do not remove them for twenty-one days. What changes in your financial life will surprise you. Rice is thrown at weddings for a reason.
Take seven grains of raw rice, only seven, place them in the palm of your right hand, and close it. Say quietly: wherever I go, may abundance go with me.
May what is mine find me. Then place the grains inside your wallet, and do not open it to check them. Every time you see them, your mind will remember what you declared.
That is not magic, my friend. That is you making space. Opportunities that seemed invisible start to appear. Money you had forgotten comes back to you.
Doors that were closed begin to open, without you understanding why. Watch for it. If you keep living from the feeling that it is never enough, no ritual will hold.
True abundance begins when there is peace inside of you. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
